sources.title: Earth cloud and night texture maps
sources.credit: Solar System Scope / INOVE, based on NASA imagery
sources.processing: Unchanged copies of existing Solsystemet derivatives: assets/orbits/clouds.jpg (2048×1024) and assets/research/earth-night-4k.jpg (4096×2048). Earlier Lanczos resizing retained; runtime downsampling may cap night map at 2048 pixels wide.
sources.limitations: Historical maps from different observations. Cloud height, shadows and drift, city-light brightness and exposure are illustrative.
